title: Noah and his sons
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child narrates Genesis 9:18-23: Noah's sons are Shem, Ham and Japheth; Noah lies uncovered in his tent, Ham sees and tells his brothers, Shem and Japheth walk in backwards and cover him without looking.

floor.question: What does Exodus 20:12 tell children to do?

representations: three name cards: Shem, Ham, Japheth
a tent drawn with two sons walking backwards
steps: Noah is uncovered in his tent.
Shem and Japheth cover him, faces turned away.
contexts: a child who hears gossip about a parent

board.do: Draw a tent and two figures walking backwards with a cloth.

board.say: Who are they and what are they doing?

board.do: Wait for the child to say Shem and Japheth covering their father.

misconceptions.ask: Which are the names of Noah's three sons?
misconceptions.repair: Read Genesis 9:18 and write the three names on a card.

misconceptions.ask: Which sons covered their father with a garment?
misconceptions.repair: Read Genesis 9:22-23 slowly, naming each son.

misconceptions.ask: What is the story in Genesis 9:18-23 mostly about?
misconceptions.repair: Say that the flood is over in this reading.

listen_for: It was not wrong; he was praised
misconceptions.ask: Why was it wrong for Ham to tell his brothers about their father (Genesis 9:22)?
misconceptions.repair: Contrast: Ham told; Shem and Japheth walked in backwards and covered him. Which honoured the father?

skills.key_step: The child explains five ways of showing respect to the elderly (greet politely, listen, give a seat, help carry, visit and run errands) and why: it pleases God.

floor.prerequisite: Knows how Noah's sons respected their father.
floor.question: How did Shem and Japheth respect Noah?

representations: a list of five ways on a hand
contexts: an old man on the matatu

board.do: Draw a hand and write "respect the elderly" on the palm.

board.say: What is one way to show respect?

board.do: Wait for the child to name one.
Write five ways, one on each finger.

listen_for: Agreeing with everything and never asking a question
misconceptions.ask: Which shows respect to an older person?
misconceptions.repair: Ask whether a polite question is respectful.

misconceptions.ask: To whom should a child show respect?
misconceptions.repair: Give a story of an older neighbour carrying water.

listen_for: So that they pay or reward us
misconceptions.ask: Why do Christians respect and help the elderly?
misconceptions.repair: Ask what Shem and Japheth gained.

listen_for: Less politely than a rich elder
misconceptions.ask: Mzee Otieno is old and poor. How should a child treat him?
misconceptions.repair: Read Leviticus 19:32: rise in the presence of the aged. Respect is for age, not money.

checks.question: Name a way to show respect to an older person.
checks.answer: Greet politely (listen, give a seat, help)
